title.zh: Strategy eyes more Bitcoin buys as Saylor touts $30B credit capacity
title.en: Strategy eyes more Bitcoin buys as Saylor touts $30B credit capacity

current_state.zh: Strategy said it could create up to $30 billion in digital credit through preferred-share offerings to fund additional Bitcoin purchases without new common-stock sales or relying on further BTC price gains.
